description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional categories in a dataset used for evaluating speaker anonymization on emotional speech, with each slice representing a distinct emotion and its corresponding proportion of the total. The chart is divided into six labeled segments: "Frustration" (25.1%, light blue), "Neutral" (23.1%, dark blue), "Happiness" (8.1%, red), "Excitement" (14.1%, orange), "Sadness" (14.7%, brown), and "Anger" (14.9%, yellow). Each category is clearly labeled with its percentage value inside the slice, and the colors are distinct and consistently applied. The largest segment corresponds to "Frustration," followed closely by "Neutral," while "Happiness" is the smallest. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with no visual emphasis such as exploded segments, and the chart does not include a separate legend, as all labels are directly placed within the slices.
